name: Meibin Chen
bio: I am a quantitative researcher who designs data-driven representations of real-world systems for forecasting and intervention evaluation. Specifically, I'm interested in how structural causality and mechanistic relationships can shape human behavior in complex systems.
My research has informed program evaluation for an NGO in Kenya, supported Gates Foundation investments in point-of-care ultrasound, and helped foreground stigma nationally in HIV service delivery.
You can read more about my ongoing work in the Research or Publications sections, or check out my GitHub, LinkedIn, or Google Scholar profiles.
